text: projectTitle: Smart Traffic Management Platform projectDescription: A platform for monitoring traffic conditions, intersections, signals, and transportation events. problemStatement: Traffic authorities need centralized visibility into changing road conditions. projectGoal: Improve coordination and monitoring of urban traffic operations. projectType: enhancement productVision: Provide traffic operators with centralized tools for monitoring and managing supported road infrastructure. entityTitle: Signal Timing Control entityDescription: Traffic signal configurations shall support cycle durations between 20 and 180 seconds.
